observations: The official description presents Rapture as an underwater refuge for society's greatest minds that became a dystopian nightmare through one man's hubris.
The player explores flooded ruins containing a changed ecosystem of Splicers, Little Sisters, and Big Daddies.
The environment, fire, water, enemies, weapons, and bodily powers are all usable parts of survival.
inferences: A location can communicate its failed founding premise through the contrast between intended function and present consequence.
Narrative and mechanics reinforce each other when the altered world state is also materially playable.
limits: The product description does not isolate audio diaries or prove individual causal interpretations.
Localized store wording may differ while describing the same release.
